verdict.rationale: Groq's docs extensively describe consuming remote MCP servers (client-side tool use), and a probe indicates a dedicated docs page at console.groq.com/docs/mcp described as an 'official MCP server', but no evidence pack content actually describes Groq itself exposing an MCP endpoint for external agents to connect to, nor any setup/auth details or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: actual documentation content confirming Groq hosts an MCP server (not just consumes them), setup/auth instructions, and independent/community verification.
